description.value: The Joe Fortes Branch is a Vancouver Public Library location tucked into the West End on Denman Street, steps from English Bay and Stanley Park — one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors. Named after Joe Fortes, the city's first official lifeguard and a beloved community figure, the branch serves a dense, walkable neighbourhood popular with cyclists. As a publicly operated library it offers a quiet, no-cost indoor space for a touring cyclist to rest, recharge, and get oriented.
